question: Should Workspaces ship the new persisted widget-state contract and a first-party persistent notes editor now, using a staged substrate-first landing?
rationale: The change creates a new persisted plugin capability and built-in product surface with compatibility and security-boundary consequences; tests cannot determine whether maintainers want to own that permanent contract.

options.title: Sponsor staged landing
options.body: Approve the state API direction, review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase this PR as a focused notes consumer with the remaining fixes and proof.

options.title: Defer the built-in editor
options.body: Keep the persistence API or notes concept in roadmap discussion until maintainers are ready to own the built-in UX and long-term plugin contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged landing
recommendation.body: Approve the state API direction, review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101329 first, then rebase this PR as a focused notes consumer with the remaining fixes and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product-routing signal in the live timeline for this Workspaces stack.
